description: Classic Japanese steamed green tea with a fresh, grassy flavor and clean finish.
Black tea scented with bergamot oil and blue cornflower petals. Citrusy and fragrant.
Rolled Anxi oolong with a floral aroma and smooth, buttery body.
Whole chamomile flowers with a hint of lemongrass. Calming and caffeine-free.
Stone-ground shade-grown tencha from Uji. Rich, smooth and vivid green.
Downy white tea buds from Fuding with a delicate, honeyed sweetness.
Aged ripe pu-erh from Yunnan. Earthy, bold and smooth.
Green tea layered with fresh jasmine blossoms for a fragrant, smooth cup.
